anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

pass_a_gloss: And it shall be kept for you until the fourteenth of this month, and all the multitude of congregation of sons of Israel shall slaughter it toward evening, and they shall take from the blood and put it upon the two posts and upon the lintel in the houses in which they eat them in them.
pass_b_english: And it shall be kept for you until the fourteenth of this month, and all the multitude of the congregation of the sons of Israel shall slaughter it toward evening, and they shall take of the blood and put it on the two doorposts and on the lintel in the houses in which they eat them (Exodus 12:6–7).
source_text: Καὶ ἔσται ὑμῖν διατετηρημένον ἕως τῆς τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτης τοῦ μηνὸς τούτου, καὶ σφάξουσιν αὐτὸ πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος συναγωγῆς υἱῶν Ἰ(σρα)ὴλ πρὸς ἑσπέραν, καὶ λήψον||[ται ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος καὶ θήσουσιν ἐπὶ τῶν δύο σταθμῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν φλιὰν ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις, ἐν οἷς ἐὰν φάγωσιν αὐτὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς].
